About

PCBoard was the dominant BBS software of the dial-up era, serving over 50,000 licensed systems worldwide. When Clark Development Company closed in the late 1990s, the source code was preserved by the community.

15.4 Revival rebuilds every binary from source using open toolchains, adds internet services (telnet, FTP, BinkP, HTTP), and keeps the software alive for a new generation.

Source code: github.com/verta1878/pcbrevival
